summary: 35928723 (120 men aged 36-55 with mild-to-moderate aging-male symptoms; LN18178 200 or 400 mg/day for 56 days) met its primary endpoint (lower AMS score vs placebo), and 35129040 (120 men aged 21-35) met its primary endpoint of higher free testosterone vs placebo at both doses. Dr. Pham's source-content hold is resolved for this exact branded blend; applicability stays limited to Tesnor/LN18178 and hormone-balance outcomes. Fourth-ruling boundary applied: fertility, erectile, hypogonadism and muscle-growth positioning excluded.

applicability.studied_population: Healthy men aged 21-55 taking Tesnor (LN18178) 200-400 mg/day for 56 days; outcomes are aging-male symptom scores and serum testosterone, not hypogonadism treatment.

identity.standardization: Aqueous-ethanol extracts of Punica granatum fruit rind and Theobroma cocoa seed 4:1, 25% excipients, >=3.5% punicalagins and >=0.5% theobromine

population.description: 120 healthy men aged 36-55 (BMI 20-29) with Aging Males' Symptoms scores of 27-43; 40 per arm.

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized (computer-generated block), double-blind, placebo-controlled, three-arm trial (CTRI/2019/02/017506), 56 days; ANCOVA between groups.

outcomes.name: Primary: change in AMS score; both 200 and 400 mg/day reduced AMS significantly versus placebo by day 56 (400 mg from day 7)
Secondary: free and total testosterone increased in both LN18178 groups (abstract reports versus baseline); hand-grip strength and PSS-10 improved

limitations: Single-country trial in men with mild-to-moderate AMS scores; 56 days only; not treatment of hypogonadism.
Whole-blend evidence: pomegranate and cocoa components cannot be credited separately; sponsor-developed patented blend.
The abstract reports testosterone change versus baseline; between-group testosterone statistics were not re-verified in this session.
Industry funded, not deficiency treatment; whole formula no individual component allocation.
Dr. Pham's fourth ruling set (2026-10-28) boundary: limited, outcome-specific credit for the exact branded formula; hormone biomarkers are not fertility, long-term health or disease prevention.
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.

co_therapies: Participants agreed to walk 30 minutes/day, five days/week, and not to start sexual-health therapies or certain supplements

source_provenance.location: Methods (LN18178 composition; participants; randomization; primary efficacy measure AMS; hormones); Results (one capsule after breakfast, 56 days; Table 3)

dose.reported_regimen: LN18178 200 or 400 mg once daily for 56 days

identity.standardization: Proprietary blend of Punica granatum fruit rind and Theobroma cocoa seed extracts (abstract)

population.description: 120 healthy male volunteers aged 21-35; 40 per group.

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled three-arm trial, 56 days.

outcomes.name: Primary: serum free testosterone increased with 200 mg (p=0.0268 vs placebo) and 400 mg (p<0.0001 vs placebo); total testosterone increased with 400 mg only (p=0.0184 vs placebo)
Secondary: LH rose with 400 mg (p=0.0470 vs placebo); DHT, cortisol and estradiol unchanged; hand-grip and MUAC improved with 400 mg

limitations: Full text not open access; PubMed abstract only. Dosage form, completer counts and funding were not verifiable.
Primary outcome is a hormone level in healthy young men, not a symptom or clinical outcome; no hypogonadism treatment claim.
Dr. Pham's fourth ruling set (2026-10-28) boundary: limited, outcome-specific credit for the exact branded formula; hormone biomarkers are not fertility, long-term health or disease prevention.
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.
